filamentSync.silentTip: This printer doesn't say what filament is loaded
filamentSync.buttonTip: Load the filaments in your printer's tool heads into this project
filamentSync.noPrinter: No printer is set up yet. Add your printer on the Device tab, then come back here.
filamentSync.silent: {{name}} doesn't say what filament is loaded, so there is nothing to load from it.
filamentSync.title: Load filaments from the printer
filamentSync.explain: Reads the material, brand and colour in each of your printer's {{noun}}s and puts them in this project's filament list, so what you slice matches what is loaded.
filamentSync.head: head
filamentSync.matchExplain_one: Keeps your {{count}} filament and what each object prints with. Each one takes the printer's filament of the same material with the closest colour; pick another if you like.
filamentSync.matchExplain_other: Keeps your {{count}} filaments and what each object prints with. Each one takes the printer's filament of the same material with the closest colour; pick another if you like.
filamentSync.addRest: Also add the filaments on the other {{noun}}s ({{list}})
filamentSync.mixesFollow: Colour mixes keep their filament numbers, so their colours follow the new filaments.
filamentSync.replaceExplain: The project's filaments become exactly what is loaded, in the printer's order.
filamentSync.replaceObjects: Objects on filament 1 go to the first one, filament 2 to the second, and so on.
filamentSync.mixesRemoved_one: Your {{count}} colour mix will be removed.
filamentSync.mixesRemoved_other: Your {{count}} colour mixes will be removed.
filamentSync.onlyMaterials: Only materials and colours are loaded. Nozzle sizes are set on the printer preset.
